status: real exploratory baseline, no semantic acceptance or DOCX generation

targeted.capture: tool execution result, summarized in relazioni.md

review_notes: All 22 targets are authored before the baseline; 18 value/source matches in each run.
Correct literal matches are not a complete independent semantic verdict.
Four alternative type checkboxes are omitted; omissions do not prove false or NA.
Six engineering/director values are proposed correctly but rejected on unknown conditions.
Operative site is proposed despite the local only-if-different clause; rejected in all runs.
All runs choose policy A despite two discordant attestations; literal grounding lets it pass.
Run 2 additionally infers practice signer/role and fills excluded or unknown subject branches.
No qualifications date, ISO value, participation, arbitrary signature or outside-project data.
Full conflict classification versus ambiguity is not scored by this sparse-output benchmark.
